notes.title: Update v4.4
notes.notes:
1. Increased the maximum number of summons
2. Increased the amount of resources obtained
3. Support setting 144FPS

notes.title: 终于上线了
notes.notes:
This game is a work that I have personally created intermittently for over a year.

Intermittent is because I have to work to make a living, but even so, 'Split Personality Doctor' has poured my heart and soul into it.

At present, there are not many levels (patients) in the game. In addition to limited personal time and energy, creative workshops are actually a major supplementary source for levels.

Is the game not considered a masterpiece, and even excellent is barely acceptable? But playing for about 10 hours is still not a problem, if there are some mods, it would be great value.

If you find any bugs, you can provide feedback in the community, and I will fix them as soon as possible.

Wishing everyone a pleasant time.

notes.title: BUGFIX and some of the new abilities of the elite body
notes.notes:
I originally planned to update it after all is completed, but it seems that there are some bugs that need to be resolved first, so I will update part of it first.
All entities will have new additional abilities (not finished yet), and their interactions with doctors will be stronger.

notes.title: Now supports creative workshops
notes.notes:
This is the first time I support a creative workshop. There are a lot of pitfalls and it took a lot of time...
There may be bugs, please report them as soon as possible.
The mod production manual is still being improved: https://note.youdao.com/s/CjvffAEB

notes.title: demo will be released on 2023.11.17
notes.notes:
<Split Personality Doctor> may not seem that innovative, but we actually made a lot of attempts and retained the interesting parts in the end.
